reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in his DM. I confirmed that his standing Marrow Agrisupply call is now Thursdays at 10:45, and told him I can't promise to remember it later. I don't keep memory between conversations and have no way to save notes, so the DM itself is the only record.

As a more reliable option, I offered to add the call to his calendar. I'd have to add each Thursday separately because I can't create repeating events, so I asked him which weeks and how long the call runs. I haven't changed anything.
